s: The state having highest per capita income is
x:
Older books and the printed key: Punjab (true up to about 2004-05). By the data current in 2012: Maharashtra (RBI 2004-05 series).
Maharashtra no longer leads these four — now Gujarat's per capita income (160.7% of the national average in 2023-24) is above Maharashtra's (150%) (EAC-PM State GDP working paper, Sep 2024)
When the question was set (2012) Maharashtra had the highest per capita NSDP among these: 2010-11 Rs 83,395 vs Gujarat 78,802, Punjab 69,580, West Bengal 47,389 (2004-05 series). Punjab led only until about 2004-05, which is why older books say Punjab (now Gujarat is ahead of Maharashtra).
